title: What is the KPMG consulting interview process, and how should you prepare?
description: How KPMG consulting tends to hire: online assessments, competency interviews, case studies and group simulations, and how to prepare.
hook: KPMG is the smallest of the Big Four by revenue but still a very large consulting employer. Its process tends to lean on online assessments, competency questions and group exercises, so preparation looks a little different from MBB.
body:
What to expect

  • Online application and assessments, often numerical, verbal and situational judgement tests.
  • Competency or behavioural interviews about times you showed teamwork, problem solving and resilience.
  • Case studies, sometimes individual and sometimes in groups.
  • Group simulations. Some KPMG offices have used a multi-hour group simulation, sometimes called Virtual Launch Pad, in place of a later interview.

How to stand out

In group exercises, assessors watch how you work with others as much as your ideas. Build on other people's points, keep the group to time, bring the discussion back to the question, and make sure quieter people are heard. Talking over people is one of the quickest ways to be marked down.

How to prepare

  • Practise timed online tests.
  • Prepare six to eight competency stories.
  • Practise a case in a small group with friends, taking turns as timekeeper and summariser.
  • Check the exact stages in your invitation, as they differ by country and role.

Sources

  • Simplify: Consulting case interview prep (Big 4 group cases)
  • Hacking the Case Interview: Big Four consulting firms

Checked November 2026. Processes change by office and year, so always confirm with the firm's own careers page and your recruiter.
